Also, my trip to Japan was incredible - the culture, the people, everything was so cool. I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it.

[D20:8] Calvin: We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called "California Love". Ah, those were the days!
